query:
SELECT 'with_filter' as type, DATE(createdAt) as date, COUNT(*) as pv, COUNT(DISTINCT ip) as uv 
FROM visitor_logs 
WHERE createdAt >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND path NOT LIKE '/src/%'
AND path NOT LIKE '/@%'
AND path NOT LIKE '/node_modules/%'
AND path NOT LIKE '/__vite%'
AND path NOT LIKE '/client/%'
AND path NOT LIKE '%.tsx'
AND path NOT LIKE '%.ts'
AND path NOT LIKE '%.css'
AND path NOT LIKE '%.js'
AND path NOT LIKE '%.map'
GROUP BY DATE(createdAt)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'without_filter' as type, DATE(createdAt) as date, COUNT(*) as pv, COUNT(DISTINCT ip) as uv
FROM visitor_logs
WHERE createdAt >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY DATE(createdAt)
